canonical_project: Cyta / RedMax Data Centre, Latsia Industrial Area
notes: Cyta press release 15/2026 (2026-07-15, browsed 2026-08-12) confirms Cyta signed agreement to acquire, upgrade and expand the RedMax Data Centre in Latsia Industrial Area; phased development with first phase commercial operation early 2027; upon completion will be Cyprus' largest privately owned data centre. A for agreement/location (Cyta official); B for trade-press specs (193 Giannou Kranidioti Ave, 1,300 sqm white space, 420 racks, 2 MW substation, 640 kWp PV/battery).
